label: The Learning Loop in six scenes

scenes.title: We collect learning activity in real time
scenes.text: The moment a learner watches a lecture, answers a quiz, submits an assignment, or asks a question, Lecognizer collects it as learning data.

scenes.title: Learning data designed with indicators and profiling
scenes.text:
We set indicators for each achievement item (1EdTech CASE)
and profile learners with an LLM.
(Patent No. 10-2767110)

scenes.title: AI finds anomaly signals first
scenes.text:
Lecognizer AI finds where pauses, rewinds, and wrong answers cluster and flags a gap in a prerequisite concept as the likely cause, with evidence.
(Patent No. 10-2883249)

scenes.title: People decide and apply
scenes.text:
LearnHubble AI suggests what to supplement from the evidence,
and the instructor decides whether and how to apply it.

scenes.title: This semester’s learning data designs next semester’s education
scenes.text:
Learners find answers on their own with AI hints when needed,
and every one of these moments becomes learning data again.
Administrators use it to refine next semester’s academic competency framework.
